had a terrible experience with this practice - Reception in particular.

I called at 8am to request an emergency phone appointment. As soon as I mentioned that I had had a fever of 39°C for three days, the receptionist interrupted me and repeatedly said, “You are not allowed to come in.” I explained that I was not asking to attend in person because I did not want to risk spreading infection, but that I urgently needed medical advice and a prescription for antibiotics.

Instead, I was told to go to a pharmacy, as they could apparently provide the medication. I walked to the pharmacy, only to be told that they were not permitted to issue anything given my high temperature, which at that point was 39.1°C.

I then called the GP practice again and spoke to the same receptionist, who simply said, “Call us again tomorrow at 8am - we don’t have any appointments today.” When I asked what I was supposed to do in the meantime, having had a very high fever for three days, she repeated that I needed to call the next morning. When I asked whether an appointment would be guaranteed, she said, “We’ll try.”

I ultimately had to pay for a private online GP consultation. After describing my symptoms and medical history, I was assessed and given a prescription within 10 minutes.

This raises serious concerns. What about patients who cannot afford private care? Why should anyone have to, when we are meant to have access to NHS services? We constantly read about people developing sepsis because they were unable to access timely medical help - this experience shows exactly how that can happen.

The receptionist was dismissive and simply wanted to get me off the phone. She did not ask for my name, date of birth, or any medical details. I have an autoimmune condition and must treat infections promptly, yet I was not given any opportunity to explain this.

This was an absolutely appalling experience and a complete failure of patient care.",null,[0,146]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/17050380032547964664/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhHZDFGWWNGTlNWMlIwVEZaS2VtSXdSWFJVZWxVeFVXdEtjVkZzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/17050380032547964664/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhHZDFGWWNGTlNWMlIwVEZaS2VtSXdSWFJVZWxVeFVXdEtjVkZzUlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/17050380032547964664/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhHZDFGWWNGTlNWMlIwVEZaS2VtSXdSWFJVZWxVeFVXdEtjVkZzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/17050380032547964664/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhHZDFGWWNGTlNWMlIwVEZaS2VtSXdSWFJVZWxVeFVXdEtjVkZzUlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/17050380032547964664/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhHZDFGWWNGTlNWMlIwVEZaS2VtSXdSWFJVZWxVeFVXdEtjVkZzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/17050380032547964664/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhHZDFGWWNGTlNWMlIwVEZaS2VtSXdSWFJVZWxVeFVXdEtjVkZzUlJBQhAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xGd1FYcFNSV2R0TFZKemIwRXRUelUxUWtKcVFsRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xd6cac0ac5ba836f2!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOlFwQXpSRWdtLVJzb0EtTzU1QkJqQlE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xGd1FYcFNSV2R0TFZKemIwRXRUelUxUWtKcVFsRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjA8Y_H8bOTAxWsAGMBHf0hJfwQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjA8Y_H8bOTAxWsAGMBHf0hJfwQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUZzWm5sUE0xOWZSV2hDWDNCRVRsY3pNelJ5WkVWcGFuVmlPRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpTUlVOYVExWmZTVGRqV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25oc1R6ZGhkRVJzZVRCSWRUVndhbmxSVWpReWNGRRAB",["0x0:0xd6cac0ac5ba836f2",null,1768225823716206,1768225823716206,[null,null,["https://
